claims.statement: For each original favorable leaf, I_(H_v)-I_(R_v) counts independent sets of H_v meeting N_T(s_v)\{v}; consequently S(T,p)=A_p-A_(p-1). The selector identity Delta_p(T-v)=Delta_p(H_v)+Delta_(p-1)(R_v) is exact. The proposed route leaves the aggregate sign implication open.
claims.scope: Finite ordinary trees under the frozen first-interior definitions, p=alpha(T)-2 and x(T)+2<=p; exact identity and open sign obligation only, with no residual hypothesis.
claims.reason: Direct set partition proves both identities, and independent exact replay confirms the cited family counts and multiplicities. The selector equation alone has no demonstrated aggregate-sign consequence under the tree and eligibility hypotheses; no positive complete sum or universal proof is supplied.

limitations: The identities do not resolve S(T,p)<=0 and do not prove that a stronger implication is impossible.
Independent family replay covers exactly m=75,100,150; small literal subset verification covers the seven-vertex path only.
Historical fence records were used for scope checks; their underlying certificates were not independently re-proved.
No Lean build or exhaustive census was performed, and no owned jobs remain.
